title: Missed Retest = Missed Trade
hook: A missed trade is not a bad trade.

launchpad.outcome: Treat a missed retest as a missed trade, never as bad analysis or a reason to chase.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What do you do when price leaves without you?

slides.headline: ICC completes. Price runs.
slides.line: Place your planned entry. Then watch what price does.

slides.headline: The retest happened. You missed it.

slides.heading: SETUP VALID · ENTRY MISSED ≠ SETUP INVALID

beats.title: Setup valid, entry missed
beats.line: The model completed. You didn’t get the retest.

slides.quote: A missed trade is not a bad trade. It’s just a trade you didn’t get.

slides.prompt: Why don’t we chase a missed retest?
slides.modelAnswer: Because the plan was the PIL retest. If it’s gone, the setup was valid but the entry was missed. Chasing creates a new rule after price moved.

remember: A missed trade is not a bad trade.
